description: This PHP source file defines a class for handling Sybase database connections and queries, including methods for transactions, querying, error handling, and date formatting. It also includes a custom record set class tailored for Sybase-specific data formats.

classes.name: ADODB_sybase
classes.description: Main class for managing Sybase database connections, transactions, and SQL execution in the ADODB PHP framework.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sybase
classes.description: Specialized record set class for handling query results from Sybase, with methods for fetching and seeking records.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_sybase
classes.description: Extends generic array-based record set to handle Sybase-specific date formats and conversions.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Retrieves the number of affected rows from the last operation.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Performs a row-level lock on specified tables and conditions.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message from the Sybase client.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Sybase database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Sybase database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against the database.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with a limit on the number of rows returned.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Converts Sybase date formats to Unix timestamps.

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts Sybase timestamp formats to Unix timestamps.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats date columns in SQL query strings based on specified formats.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a given table.
